description: Defines the QuicInterval template class used for representing and manipulating contiguous ranges over ordered types, including operations like containment, intersection, union, and difference.

classes.name: quic::QuicInterval
classes.description: A template class representing a half-open interval [min, max) over an ordered type T, supporting operations like containment, intersection, union, and difference.

methods.name: Intersects
methods.description: Checks if this interval intersects with another, optionally returning the intersection.

methods.name: IntersectWith
methods.description: Modifies this interval to be its intersection with another.

methods.name: SpanningUnion
methods.description: Expands this interval to include another, forming their union.

methods.name: Difference
methods.description: Calculates the difference between this interval and another, returning resulting intervals.

methods.name: Difference (overloaded)
methods.description: Calculates the difference and stores results in provided out parameters.
